name: Jezero Crater east floor, Mars (CTX-only test site)
description: Portability test: an area with no 1 m DTM coverage, built only from the 20 m CTX DEM. Proves the pipeline and engine run on any site with a DEM; confidence and soft-soil uncertainty reflect the coarser data.
